description.text: Chinese Language Center was established in 1997. Till now, 1000 international students from 20 countries have finished their study at the center. An annual enrollment of the Chinese language programs is about 120 and the students are arranged into 8-10 classes. The center has 8 full-time and 4 part-time professional language teachers. They are all qualified and have been granted the Certificate of Teaching Chinese Language by the Ministry of Education of China. The programs are specially prepared for those foreign students who intend to study or work or travel in China, or who are interested in Chinese language and culture. It also aims to improve the Chinese language ability of overseas students studying in CUPB. Features Lowest tuition: In Beijing for similar programs Super quality: A high percentage of our students can pass the national HSk tests after one year's study Extra content: Technical Chinese Course is added; Emphasis on communicative ability Small class size: No more than 15 students in one class Individual tutors: Each student has a personal tutor for after-class assistance Curriculum Chinese Speaking, Listening, Reading, Language Practice-discovery of Beijing (Three sight-seeing trips) Fees Insurance: RMB 600/year Accommodation: RMB 1200/year for small room and RMB 1500/year for big room. Notes: Double room with air-condition,television,washing room,kitchen and etc.

duration.text: The Chinese Language Program at China University of Petroleum - Beijing is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1458 USD/per semester ￥ 10500 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of highest education 5.The identity certificate of the guarantors charging your case in China For example, photocopy of ID card, photocopy of passport, etc.

requirements.text: The beginners who would like to have a brief experience in Chinese language learning for the purpose of travel or for future Chinese language studies; or who are interested in Chinese culture. No Chinese background required.
